Comment: Triggers Typology Subgraph Pipeline when document ingestion completes for a case

Rule.Name: TypologyPipelineTrigger
Rule.Description: Auto-triggers typology pre-computation pipeline when ingestion completes

Notes.how_to_emit: After ingestion pipeline completes, emit: events.put_events(Source='investigative-intelligence.ingestion', DetailType='Ingestion Complete', Detail=json.dumps({'case_id': case_id, 'status': 'completed', 'document_count': N}))
Notes.iam_role: The EventBridgeStepFunctionsRole needs states:StartExecution permission on the TypologySubgraphPipeline state machine
